Fun Facts[]

  • This station shares structure with the Hokuto Ferry Terminal above.
  • The Hokuto Ferry Terminal provides car and passenger ferry services to and from Yowah with three piers and was the only means of external vehicular access in Coopol prior to the completion of the Ingress Transcontinental Highway. Currently this pier is still used by Dangerous Goods vehicles to connect with the rest of the road network in Los Sengas.
  • This Stop is the first known SLT stop to adopt an Oceanfloor Structure.

Hook Sand Line is one of the lines constructed in Period 5, as well as the Continuous Development Phase of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It currently has 33 stations, and is a south-north oriented line connecting Egress with Yowah, Punctual, Oasis and Oasis Bay.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Developmental History
  • 3 Districts Served
  • 4 Line Characteristics
  • 5 Fun Facts
  • 6 List of Stations
  • 7 Gallery
  • 8 Citations and References

History[]

This line was originally planned to be a connecting line between Punctual and northern Yowah, with termini being set up at Kelper Mount and Xylog Cliff, with space reserved for extension to Torrent. However, the appearance of Punctual Line in Friendly Railways and Prosand Corridor in Arcgo City Railway caused drastic changes to development plans.

While the modified plans did not alter any stations between Prosand and Yowah North, the termini of this line has been changed to Compahills and Unbalanced Bay, causing this line to become the connecting line between Yowah and South Egress.

After Phase I development was complete, the original plans involved extending to a terracotta mesa in north Egress , but after repeated changes and due to geological constraints, the plans have been modified to connect this line to Egress Town Center and provide a north-south express service in east Los Sengas.

To the south of Compahills, completion of Oasis Bay Development also menat that feasibility studies could now be conducted regarding the southern extension of Hook Sand Line to Oasis Bay, and final plans saw this line using Charm River as the terminus.

Developmental History[]

Co-Op Railway Period 5:

  • S1E2: Compahills / Spinstone End - Prosand
  • S1E3: Compahills / Spinstone End - Yowah North
  • S1E4: Compahills / Spinstone End - Unbalanced Bay

Continuous Development Phase:

  • March 4 2022: The section between Litchi Lake and Mount Wetlands (In Punctual) is approved.
  • March 23 2022: The section between Victorion and Mount Wetlands began services.
  • June 7 2022: The sections between Mansgrove and Wooden Abyss (In Oasis) and Hammer Bay and Out Sand (In Egress) are approved.
  • November 3 2022: The section between Hammer Bay and Grassharp (In Egress) began services.
  • November 6 2022: The section between Rapid Rivulet and Out Sand (In Egress) began services, but Hook Sand Rapid has yet to reach that section.
  • November 11 2022: The Hook Sand Rapid section between Unbalanced Bay and Rapid Rivulet (In Egress) began services.
  • November 12 2022: The section between Mount Wetlands and North Wooden Abyss (In Oasis) began services, but Hook Sand Rapid has yet to reach that section.
  • November 13 2022: The section between North Wooden Abyss and Wooden Abyss (In Oasis) and the Hook Sand Rapid section between Litchi Lake and Wooden Abyss began services. Continuous Development Phase of that period is complete.
  • January 24 2023: The section between Wooden Abyss and Charm River (In Oasis Bay), as well as the direct services to Southern Corridor and East Terrace (In Egress) are approved.
  • May 20 2023: The section between Mount Spadrago and Wooden Abyss (In Oasis Bay) began services for Hook Sand Line.
  • May 21 2023: The section between Charm River and Mount Spadrago (In Oasis Bay) began services for Hook Sand Line.
  • June 5 2023: The section between Charm River and Wooden Abyss began services for Hook Sand Rapid.
  • June 19 2023: The section between Old Brightland and Rapid Rivulet began services for Hook Sand Express.

Districts Served[]

  • Oasis Bay
  • Oasis
  • Punctual
  • Yowah
  • Egress

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the lines in Period 5 and the Continuous Development Phase of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme.
  • The section between Prosand and Yowah North was referred to as the "Yowah Connection Line", which shortens travel time between these two stations down to seven minutes.
  • This line is a line to contain an express line and a branch line at the same time.

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line runs at the standards of a sub-standard railway with trains that are 152m long (Hence the fact that most stations built in the earlier stages have this platform length), as the line extends, platforms have been lengthened to 204m in order to improve the design and overcome spatial limitations.
  • This line interchanges with NAR Snow White Line at Tea Pond Station and Howard Canyon Station, and features a direct service with Southern Corridor up to Cityyard Shrine. This section is also considered a connection of NAR's overall network despite being operated by EHT.

Fun Facts[]

  • As this station neighbors the Sava Racecourse, this station was originally planned to be named Sava Racecourse Station. However, during construction of this station, this station is renamed after the island on which this station is located, Horsepower Island Station.
  • Due to the short distance between this station and Rover Down Checkpoint, the "Next Station" and "Approaching" announcements of Golf Line was not separated like in other sections. Instead, these announcements have been merged and was played upon leaving this station. A similar arrangement could be found between Virtel Heights Station and Intus Orient Gateway of the Bravo Line.
  • To allude to the nearby Sava Racecourse, a Race Track that circumnavigates this station exist between the Platform Level and the Concourse Level of this station.
  • This Station is the first station in Sava Line to adopt the left-hand traffic rule and feature Platform Gates upon construction.

History[]

  • July 28 2020: To compliment the construction of this station, the Platform Signs of Sava Line have been replaced in advance.[2]
  • July 29 2020: This Station began Construction.
  • July 31 2020: This station began services. Golf Line is established.
  • July 23 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[3]

Description []

Hotel Line will be one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

This route will be represented by Purple on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and will be Line Number H.

History[]

  • This line was formerly named Hopps Line, but was renamed to the currently name due to historical reasons.
  • While the original color scheme of this line was #0000C6, it was modified to the current #4F00A1.

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Westwards from the Zero Station of Centopia to Xofa District. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Northwest from Centopia to Apple Hill Station through Orama Island and West Xofa, interchanging with Zephyr Line, Sparkling Line and Fox Line in the process. TBC

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

Fun Facts[]

  • While this line has yet to be established, reserved platforms for this line are seen at Daring Line, Utopia Line, Zephyr Line, Sparkling Line, Alpha Line Centopia, and it is also known that Centopia is the "Zero Station" of Zephyr Line, Sparkling Line and this line.

Train Intervals (Tentative)[]

Time of Day Train Intervals (In Minutes)

Midnight Period 30

Rolling Stock[]

Hotel Line will use V-stock throughout. However, in busy times, the N-Stock might also used to alleviate crowds.

Length[]

All Stations along the line will adopt the standard platform length of 204m.

Platform Screen Doors/Gates[]

Fifth Anniversary Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0
  • Just walk along the Concourse to find souvenir.
  • The Fifth Anniversary Souvenir comes in the form of The Door of Humility.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Door of Humility is a special souvenir that could only be obtained from this station.
  • The sides of this station is shaped like an hourglass. As a result, the Lower Platforms are narrower than that of the Upper Platforms.

History[]

  • June 30 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line, but New Edward Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • July 1 2017: New Edward Line extended from Justin Station to this Station through Litchi Lake Station and Newmonth River Station.
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[2]

title: Huntington
safeHtml:
Huntington, formerly named Blufield , is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Southeasterly Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-13.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Major Roads
  • 3 Citations and References

History[]

The name of this Sub-District originates from the fact that it was the resting place for many Expedition Parties who tried to map the Ingress Continent, and with the increase in the number of Hunters and Expedition Parties, this area eventually gave birth to the name of Huntington. The former name of this District, Blufield, also stemmed from the fact that rivers passing through this area would have its water turn into a pristine blue color.

Huntington was formerly planned to be a Commercial District, but ultimately became a scientific research area due to replanning, and is also one of the Sub-Districts with the most job opportunities in Asylum. The Developer of Asylum also had plans to reserve stations for Ingress Line at the east of Huntington for the convenience of commuters. However, after Nazca Railway released plans for the Ingress Continent in the 2024 Development Plans, it was revealed that Ingress Line would take a detour to the east, and this plan was also scrapped.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Forked Mirage.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Gleams Between the Rails".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Forked Mirage 02:15
Whispers of the Twin Currents 03:27

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that there is a river flowing between two rivers near this station, forming a shape resembling the letter "I".
  • This is the first station to adopt the Heightened Basic Platform Gates.

History[]

  • October 25 2016: This station began services.
  • December 24 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • May 23 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station, alongside Flamelute Island Station, is built to commemorate the Iceflame Main Server, a Hong Kong-based Minecraft Server.
  • To correspond to the theme of "Ice", cool colors are used at this station, and the concourse is in the shape of the letter "I". Moreover, Packed Ice also exists at the sides of the platforms.
  • This station is the first station to be built with ImageOnMap (IoM) Signs upon construction.[2]

History[]

  • July 29 2017: This Station began construction.[3]
  • July 30 2017: This Station completed construction.[4]
  • August 2 2017: This Station began services.
  • August 9 2022: Exit C is added to this station to connect to Mushroom Transit Ice-Flamelute Station.[5]

Icy Lava Station is a station on Glacier Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Snowty. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 2800 (Icy Lava NR Station Stop).

  • The Glacier Express passing tracks of this station has a signage with futuristic text at the north and south ends of this station.

title: In-Station Transit
safeHtml:
The In-Station Transit is a type of transportation in Nazca Railway that connects passengers within the station, or from the concourse to its outlying exits. This method is mostly used in Island (Type IV) Stations, but examples of In-Station Transits also exist in other Station Types.

Contents

  • 1 Style
  • 2 List of Stations with In-Station Transits
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway
    • 2.2 Co-Op Railways
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Citations and References

Style[]

Stations of In-Station Transits mostly follow the Platform Design from Terracept Division, and all its stations have their own names and color themes.

List of Stations with In-Station Transits[]

Nazca Railway[]

  • Terracept Terminal (Terracept Internal People Mover)
  • Earn Island Station (Earn Island In-Station Transit)
  • Tenbal Island Station (Tenbal Island In-Station Transit)
  • Peacean Island Station (Peacean Island In-Station Transit)
  • Summer Point Gateway (Summer Point In-Station Transit)
  • Old Brightland Checkpoint (Old Brightland In-Station Transit)
  • Goalkeep Corner Station (Goalkeep Corner In-Station Transit)
  • Deepond Island Station (Deepond Island In-Station Transit)

Co-Op Railways[]

  • Downtown Transit Polibiomes Station (Polibiomes In-Station Transit)

Fun Facts[]

  • In-Station Transits first appeared as "Internal People Movers" in Terracept Terminal in the form of the Terracept Internal People Mover, but the first station to feature In-Station Transits in Los Sengas Division did not appear until S2E19, when the Earn Island In-Station Transit is built at Earn Island Station.
  • Currently, the only Co-Op Railway Station to feature this method is Downtown Transit Polibiomes Station, which is built with the purpose of connecting passengers to the Nazca Railway Polibiomes Station.[1]
  • The deepest section of Nazca Railway in Los Sengas Division is an underwater section of Tenbal Island In-Station Transit at Y=2.
  • Deepond Island Station on the Arcgo Line and Interisland Line features the first and currently only station to have two In-Station Transit Lines, namely the East-West Line and North-South Line.
  • Old Brightland Checkpoint is the only checkpoint class station to feature this method.
  • Summer Point Gateway is the only gateway class station to feature this method.

Citations and References[]

  1. ↑ While Summer Point Gateway also involved Nawis Railway, it is not considered a Co-Op Railway Station in this page as it was built by Nazca Railway.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first station built at the Twenty-Second Continent in Los Sengas Division.
  • This station is named after the theme of an orientation camp in which the railway builder participated in.[2]
  • A Station Art featuring lyrics from a song by Supper Moment, a Hong Kong-based rock band, is seen at the concourse of this station.
  • A set of passageways are seen at both ends of the concourse, which does not occupy the full length of the platforms. While the west passageways only lead to the platform, the east passageways can lead to Exit C. Passengers from Exit C could also access the platforms directly and skip the concourse of this station.
  • The platforms of this station are 300m long, 96m longer than the standard length of 204m. As a result, two separate sets of switches used to control the east and west parts of the platform gates are present at both platforms of this station. A similar system is implemented at Dragon Spade Station of Terracept Division.

History[]

  • September 16 2015: This station began services.
  • August 12 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • February 27 2023: This station finished upgrading its exits.[4]
  • July 21 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

title: Info Island Railway
safeHtml:
Info Island Railway is the Light Rail System on Info Island.

Station List[]

Currently, Info Island Railway has three lines with ten stations. However, it is planned to have four lines with eleven stations. The stations of Info Island Railway are as follows, with Italic Text indicating that the station is not yet open:

  • Northern Line:
    • Info Island NR Station (Interchange with Nazca Railway Stadium Line, Interisland Line)
    • Info Estate Station (Interchange with Northern Line Spur, Southern Line, Island Circular Line)
    • Golden Park Station (Interchange with Island Circular Line)
  • Northern Line Spur:
    • Info Estate Station (Interchange with Northern Line, Southern Line, Island Circular Line)
    • Info Cinema Station
    • Rich Estate Station (Interchange with Island Circular Line)
  • Southern Line:
    • Info Estate Station (Interchange with Northern Line, Northern Line Spur, Island Circular Line)
    • South Info Coast Station
    • South Info Central Station (Interchange with Thunder Line, Island Circular Line)
    • MogeFox Station (Interchange with Thunder Line)
    • Southern Isle Station
  • Thunder Line:
    • South Info Central Station (Interchange with Southern Line, Island Circular Line)
    • MogeFox Station (Interchange with Southern Line)
    • Thunder Mountain Station
  • Island Circular Line:
    • Info Estate Station (Interchange with Northern Line, Northern Line Spur, Southern Line)
    • South Info Central Station (Interchange with Southern Line, Thunder Line)
    • Info Island Hospital Station
    • Golden Park Station (Interchange with Northern Line)
    • Rich Estate Station (Interchange with Northern Line Spur)
    • Info Beach Station

After Info Beach Station, Island Circular Line will go back to Info Estate Station.

Info Island Station is a station on Stadium Line and Interisland Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Info Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to Info Island Railway Northern Line Info Island NR and Info Cinema stations, as well as Info Island Railway Island Circular Line (Info Beach Station) in the future.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • One player is enough
  • Find the Station Souvenir. It is NOT located within the station. In fact, it is very far away from it, albeit within the island.
  • You will need to fly to reach the souvenir.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a book.

History[]

  • June 29 2015: This station began services alongside Stadium Line.
  • May 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • April 2 2017: The Interisland Line part completed expansion.
  • April 4 2017: Interisland Line extends from Fire Two Island Station to this station.
  • January 20 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • March 2 2020: Due to historical reasons, services for Stadium Line are suspended. However, operations for Interisland Line remain as normal.[5][6][7]
  • November 1 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
